The '''HM-6 Concussion Missile Launcher''' was a model of [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]] manufactured by [[Dymek/Legends|Dymek]]. The launcher had a magazine of six [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] were fitted with a pair of HM-6 launchers.<ref name="EGWT" />
